slides.stat_label: Kerala HC Suggests Revisiting the Juvenile Age
bullets: Justice A. Badharudeen cited 'sufficient maturity' at 16
An observation addressed to legislatures, not a binding order
Juvenile Justice Act is central law, passed by Parliament

slides.stat_label: What the Juvenile Justice Act Allows Today
bullets: Section 15: board assesses teens accused of heinous offences
Teen may then face trial as an adult
Heinous means a minimum jail term of seven years
slides.credit_line: Sources: Juvenile Justice Act 2015, PRS Legislative Research

slides.stat_label: Next Hearing in Kerala's Underage Drinking Case
bullets: Kerala's Abkari Act bars liquor to anyone under 23
Petitioner sought ID checks, licence action against bars
Excise Commissioner must file statement on enforcement steps
